systems.system: RPPCUB-2026 digitised geo-referenced register of urban property owners, with a Web GIS platform
systems.country_label: Recensement des propriétaires des propriétés ou parcelles dans les centres urbains du Burundi (RPPCUB-2026); plateforme géographique (Web SIG)
systems.owner: Government of Burundi; technical presentation by INSBU, with a steering committee
systems.tiers: first phase: urban communes of Muha, Mukaza and Ntahangwa and the towns of Gitega, Ngozi and Rumonge; national extension planned

note: A census-built land register launched 14 July 2026; the document does not say communes work in it and states no connection of commune offices.
